name: x2611_15512_thm2_3
statement:
{V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.IsBipartite) :
  ∃ (H : G.Subgraph) (C : Set V), H.IsMatching ∧ G.IsVertexCover C ∧
    H.edgeSet.ncard = C.ncard ∧
    (∀ N : G.Subgraph, N.IsMatching → N.edgeSet.ncard ≤ H.edgeSet.ncard) ∧
    (∀ D : Set V, G.IsVertexCover D → C.ncard ≤ D.ncard)
closed:
∀ {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.IsBipartite), ∃ (H : G.Subgraph) (C : Set V), H.IsMatching ∧ G.IsVertexCover C ∧
    H.edgeSet.ncard = C.ncard ∧
    (∀ N : G.Subgraph, N.IsMatching → N.edgeSet.ncard ≤ H.edgeSet.ncard) ∧
    (∀ D : Set V, G.IsVertexCover D → C.ncard ≤ D.ncard)
original:
In a bipartite graph, the maximum size of a matching equals the
minimum size of a vertex cover.
